page_title: EMP 0-0 UDI | Empoli v Udinese 06/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the left post so the goalkeeper can relax.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing from Empoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Marco Silvestri scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
88' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
84' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) picked up a yellow card from referee.
81' Substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
81' Marley Ake (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hassane Kamara.
81' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) replacing Tommaso Baldanzi.
81' It's time for a substitution. Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) comes on in place of Razvan Marin.
80' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) for Francesco Caputo.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ardian Ismajli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli).
72' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
71' Andrea Sottil has decided to make a change. Martin Payero (Udinese) replaces Roberto Pereyra.
71' Substitution. Joao Ferreira (Udinese) in, Festy Ebosele out.
68' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Etrit Berisha comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
66' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
66' Isaac Success (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
65' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
64' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
63' A substitution has been made. Lorenzo Lucca goes off and Isaac Success (Udinese) comes on.
63' The game is interrupted now, Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
60' The Empoli players are stunned as referee Michael Fabbri changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
60' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Empoli using VAR. Let's see what happens.
59' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is going to take the penalty!
58' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) and blew his whistle. PENALTY to Empoli! Great chance to score.
57' Fine attempt! Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
56' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' Razvan Marin (Empoli) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
53' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) releases Francesco Caputo with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
50' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
49' The foul by Liberato Cacace (Empoli) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Etrit Berisha punches the ball away.
44' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
42' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends it out of play.
40' The goal by Empoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
40' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Empoli players aren’t happy.
39' Goal! Francesco Caputo (Empoli) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:0.
38' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) tries to find Francesco Caputo, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

36' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Marco Silvestri has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Hassane Kamara (Udinese), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
28' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
28' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Etrit Berisha intercepts the ball.
26' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) receives a reproachful look from Florian Thauvin. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
24' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

20' Razvan Marin (Empoli) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Marco Silvestri, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
19' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
19' Razvan Marin (Empoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

18' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
16' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
13' Great ball in from Lorenzo Lucca. Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
12' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

11' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
10' Razvan Marin (Empoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
9' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Razvan Marin (Empoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
2' The Empoli players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
